room.ferry_landing.title: Ferry Landing
room.ferry_landing.description: Reeds crowd a slick wooden landing. A [mooring post](mooring_post) leans into the current.
room.village_green.title: Village Green
room.village_green.description: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass.
detail.mooring_post: Rope has worn a groove into the [post]. Someone has carved a fox into it.
npc.bram.room: [Bram] the ferryman stands here, one boot on the ferry.
npc.bram.description: A ferryman with rope-scarred hands and a coat that has never been dry.
item.lantern.room: A [brass lantern] lies in the weeds.
item.lantern.room_oil: A [brass lantern] lies in the weeds, dry. The oil you carry would fill it.
item.lantern.description: Dented brass, its reservoir dry. It would light a fen path.
item.satchel.room: A leather [satchel] leans against a crate.
item.satchel.description: Scuffed leather, buckled shut over something that sloshes.
item.lamp_oil.room: A [flask of lamp oil] stands here.
item.lamp_oil.description: Thick yellow oil, enough for one lantern.
